-- True when `path` stays inside the notes directory once its
-- `..` segments are resolved. Absolute paths and any path that
-- climbs above the root are rejected. Pure: no capabilities.
is_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or path.char_count() > 0
  ex is_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex is_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex is_inside("..") == False
  ex is_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex is_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  if path.char_count() > 0 and parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for seg in parts
    if seg == "" or seg == "."
      continue
    if seg == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth += 1
  True

-- Text of notes/<path>, or "" when the path leaves notes or the
-- file is missing or unreadable. Reads go only through an fs
-- narrowed to the notes directory.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_inside(path) or out == ""
  ex read_public("") == ""
  ex read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  ex read_public("no-such-file.txt") == ""
  if is_inside(path) == False
    return ""
  var result = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(path) else err -> ""
    result = text
  result
